description_md:
Mistral Vibe Hackathon
Practical Info
Dates: Saturday, Nov 21 - One Day Hackathon
Schedule: From 8:30 AM to 8:30 PM.
Must be 18+ to participate
Teams: 3-5 people
Exact venue details will be accessible to selected participants
All applications are reviewed by the Mistral team on a rolling basis
Selected participants will receive confirmation one week before the event
Breakfast, lunch & dinner will be provided to all hackers throughout the day
Before event day: find your teammates or we will help you find one on the spot.

Prizes
🥇 1st place
$3,000 Mistral credits
🥈 2nd place
$2,000 Mistral credits
🥉 3rd place
$1,000 Mistral credits

Judges
Judging panel composed of AI engineers, software engineers, TPM, and AI scientists from Mistral
